summary: A precise nocturnal system where one dominant visual field carries the technical narrative.
visual_thesis: Make system relationships feel engineered, spatial, and continuous rather than boxed into feature cards.
composition_behavior: one dominant diagram or visual field per page
asymmetric massing with quiet text zones
anti_patterns: equal card grid without semantic equality
decorative circuit lines unrelated to content
tiny body copy used to preserve density
prompt_fragment: Use a dark engineered visual field, asymmetrical scale contrast, one dominant system relationship, and restrained luminous accents.
review_focus: Does the diagram carry the page memory?
Are glow and lines explaining a relationship rather than decorating?
Is the text readable against the dark field?
